description:
[Filings Oracle] Structured SEC filings feed (8-K, Form 4, Schedule 13D/13G, 10-K, 10-Q), ingested within about a minute of SEC acceptance — Structured SEC filings feed (8-K, Form 4, Schedule 13D/13G, 10-K, 10-Q), ingested within about a minute of SEC acceptance. Filter by form, ticker, CIK or 8-K item; page with a cursor, or long-poll with wait= to receive the next filing the moment it lands.

**Example:** `/v1/filings?form=8-K&item=5.02&days=1`

days.description: Optional. Look back N days (default 2, max 90). Ignored when since is set.

form.description: Optional. Comma list: 8-K, 4, SCHEDULE 13D, SCHEDULE 13G, 10-K, 10-Q (amendments included). Default all.

item.description: Optional. 8-K item number, e.g. 5.02 (executive change) or 2.02 (earnings).

since.description: Optional. Cursor from a previous response (meta.cursor): returns only filings stored after it, oldest first.

wait.description: Optional. With since: hold the request up to N seconds (max 25) until a new filing arrives.

name: filings_search
